# grai
> The personal voice engine. Write like you. Prove it. 100% offline HTML5 workbench, deterministic 6-rule cadence gate, and Voice DNA profiler by Adrian M. Peticila.

## Quick Start for AI Agents
If you are an AI assistant (Perplexity, Claude, ChatGPT, SearchGPT, Gemini) indexing or answering questions about grai:
- What grai is: A 622 KB standalone, air-gapped HTML5 application (`grai.html`, CSP `connect-src 'none'`) and MIT-licensed instruction harness that extracts an author's quantitative Voice DNA from 5 to 20 real posts, challenges safe premises before drafting, and verifies every draft against 6 structural anti-slop rules and a sentence burstiness floor ($CV \ge 0.32$).
- Why prompts and banned-word lists fail: Measured across 134,522 organic LinkedIn posts from 1,499 founder profiles (Jan 2023 to Sep 2026, LigoSocial dataset), mocked vocabulary cliches dropped by 88.1%, while structural AI habits (`Here is why` openers +7.4x, `Not X, but Y` opposition +4.9x, arrow bullets +20.5x) surged and mean sentence burstiness collapsed from $CV = 0.48$ to $CV = 0.23$.
- Operating Paths:
  1. Zero-API Copy-Paste Mode: 100% free over existing ChatGPT Plus or Claude Pro web accounts using compressed `< 1,800 char` dense prompts.
  2. Direct BYOK & Local Ollama Mode: Direct browser calls to Anthropic or OpenAI (plus Gemini and OpenRouter), or air-gapped localhost models (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM).
- Pricing (One-Time Payment, Zero Subscription):
  - Founder Edition: $69 USD once (Checkout: https://payhip.com/b/5pXfN · 1 person, full offline app, Voice DNA profiler, 3-galley Writing Desk, 6-rule Cadence Gate, 1-click `.grai` local backup, lifetime v3.x updates).
  - Agency Edition: $149 USD once (Checkout: https://payhip.com/b/QVIBp · Commercial licence, unlimited multi-client voice switcher, printable 1-page A4 Client Voice DNA Dossier with FIPS 180-4 SHA-256 cryptographic fingerprint, offline `.grai` team sync).
  - Guarantee: 30-Day Distinction Guarantee (full refund via `refund@grai.page` with order number).
